300188.SZ.longBusinessSummary: SDIC Intelligence Information Technology Co., Ltd. provides digital forensics and public security big data products and services in China and internationally. The company offers Xueling project, financial risk monitoring, and electronic data forensics lab solutions; smart monitoring solutions; smart tax collection and administration, and smart inspection solutions; customs anti-smuggling solutions; smart railway solutions; and smart emergency response and fire investigation solutions. It also provides smart party building, converged media, smart scenic area, smart airport, and smart park solutions; education business line solutions; and urban public safety and smart community solutions, as well as overall solution for intelligent platform for urban social governance. In addition, the company offers skyscanner big data operation and maintenance, tiansuan big data modeling, and space-based big data governance solutions; and data security, zero trust, cybersecurity classified protection, and data asset management and database scanning system solutions. Further, it provides electronic data forensics, public safety big data, new cyberspace security, and digital government and enterprise digitalization products; and scientific research platform. SDIC Intelligence Information Technology Co., Ltd. was formerly known as SDIC Intelligence Xiamen Information Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SDIC Intelligence Information Technology Co., Ltd. in October 2025. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.

300196.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Jiangsu Changhai Composite Materials Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of glass fiber products and composite materials. It offers glass roving products, including felt yarn, SMC sheet, textile type direct, chopped fiber, winding type direct, jet, roof, plied drawn, and glass fiber chopped felt yarn, as well as plied yarn for pipe short cut, yarn for transparent plate, glass fiber for continuous pipes, and direct yarn for pultrusion and for weaving. The company also provides fiberglass products, such as glass chopped strand mats, glass fiber wet mats, fiberglass fabric, fiberglass coated mats, fiberglass partitions, fiberglass continuous mats, and fiberglass mesh; thermoplastic glass fiber and its products, including thermoplastic fiberglass, continuous fiber reinforced thermoplastic prepreg tapes, reinforced polypropylene composite boards, thermoplastic fiberglass, thermoplastic honeycomb composite panels, and thermoplastic foam insulation composite boards; and glass fiber for wind power and photovoltaic. In addition, it is involved in manufacturing unsaturated polyester resin; sale of methyl ethyl ketone peroxide, FRP products, chemical raw materials, and glass fiber raw materials; and testing, technical training, and consulting operations for FRP and its raw and auxiliary materials. The company sells its products in China, North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Oceania, Africa, and internationally. Jiangsu Changhai Composite Materials Co., Ltd was founded in 2000 and is based in Changzhou, China.

300207.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Sunwoda Electronic Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, and manufacturing of lithium-ion batteries in China and internationally. It operates through Consumer Batteries, Electric Vehicle Batteries, Energy Storage Systems, and Other segments. The company offers 3C consumer batteries, such as mobile phone, tablet, laptop, smart mobility, and intelligent hardware batteries, as well as power bank and electric tool products, and PCBA, and precision structural components; electric vehicle, HybridSPC, and Hyb.PV passenger car solutions; and heavy-duty trucks, bus, and logistics vehicle solutions. It also provides marine vessels and low-altitude economy solutions; BMS, domain controller, vehicle power supply, and BDU solutions; energy services, including zero carbon solutions and energy storage services; intelligent commercial, health and personal care, AI audio-visual, smart robotics, smart home products, VR wearable, and smart mobility products; and electronic pens and accessories. In addition, it is involved in detection business; technology promotion and application services; civil engineering construction industry business; loading, unloading and warehousing industry; software and information technology services; electricity and heat production and supply industry business; and financial industry business. Sunwoda Electronic Co.,Ltd was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

It also offers TRS-GPT LLM, a professional LLM for media, finance, network information, public security, patents, and security industries; Ude, a one-stop question and answer agent development platform; TRS DT-AI platform, which provides full-process services of traditional machine learning and deep learning development, deployment, application, and operation and maintenance; TRS IS- computer vision software product for searching similar content fragments between images and videos; and AnTuo Knowledge Graph Platform, a big data knowledge graph product. Further, the company provides content contribution, clue discovery, hotspot analysis, propagation analysis, ranking analysis, thematic tracking, and standardized API open cloud service; and Dataelite Industrial Brain, an industrial chain knowledge engine. 300285.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Shandong Sinocera Functional Material Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of ceramic materials and products in China and internationally. The company operates through six segments: Electronic Materials, Catalytic Materials, Biomedical Materials, New Energy Materials, Precision Ceramics, and Digital Printing and Other Materials. It offers ceramic powders and basic materials, including MLCC dielectric material, zirconia, alumina, boehmite, electronic paste, solar electronic paste, and filler for high-frequency copper-clad laminate; catalytic materials, such as honeycomb ceramic, zeolite, and cerium zirconium oxide mixture; and biomedical materials comprising zirconia ceramics for all-ceramic denture and preformed polymer-based crown and bridge. The company also provides ceramic ball, structure, and substrate; conventional, ultra-soft, and ultra-thin thermal gap fillers; and ceramic inks and pigments, as well as materials for HD display. In addition, it is involved in technology promotion and application services; wholesale of non-metallic minerals and products; business services; pharmaceutical manufacturing; computer, communication, and other electronic equipment manufacturing; property management; and real estate development and operation. The company's products are used in consumer electronics, vehicle, biomedical and catalytic materials, home decor, and ceramic structure applications. It exports its products. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Dongying, China.

300308.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. research and development, design, manufacturing, and sales of high-speed optical transceivers in China, United States, Singapore, Netherlands, United Kingdom, and Hong Kong. The company offers products, such as a comprehensive portfolio of optical transceivers from 10G to 1.6T, including modules for 400G, 800G, and 1.6T applications; components in optical transceivers and related optical communication equipment, including Transistor Outline Can (TO-CAN) packaged components; and in-vehicle optical transmission solutions for fiber to the vehicle (FTTV) deployment. It also offers services, including the design, research, and manufacturing of high-end optical communication modules and intelligent equipment. The company's product applications include cloud and AI infrastructure, coherent and transport networks, datacom, and telecom. Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shandong Zhongji Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. in September 2017. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Longkou, China.
